# Bioregional Finance Wiki

> A shared, open knowledge base on bioregional finance, kept by Dark Matter Labs and partners. Read-only. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

Cite pages by title and URL. Each page states its confidence and who has reviewed it (`validation`). `machine` means an AI wrote it and no person has confirmed it yet. How to read and cite: https://dark-matter-labs.github.io/bioregional-finance-wiki-public/AGENTS.md

## Pages

- [About the Bioregional Finance Wiki](https://dark-matter-labs.github.io/bioregional-finance-wiki-public/wiki/about.md): What this wiki covers, who keeps it, how it is made, and how to suggest a source.
